dungeon-crawler.title: Dungeon Crawler: Explore and Conquer Ancient Treasures
dungeon-crawler.slogan: Embark on a journey to find ancient treasures in Dungeon Crawler!
dungeon-crawler.description: Dungeon Crawler is a mysterious action-adventure role-playing game where you play as a brave hero venturing into dark and dangerous dungeons. Explore, fight monsters, collect treasure, and upgrade your character to become stronger. With a rich combat system and an engaging storyline, Dungeon Crawler offers a dramatic and challenging experience. Are you ready to become an invincible warrior? Let’s explore and conquer!

HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: Upgrade your character's skills and attributes with experience gained from battle.
